integrity: Exact outer distance-multiset formulas yield a sharp n-1 lower bound. Equality forces one landmark from each shifted pair; cross-side representations then collide exactly when the two side landmark counts are equal, producing the odd-order balanced obstruction and the complete basis count.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats canonical half graphs rather than arbitrary chain graphs with repeated twin classes.
Finite exhaustive verification covers n from two through ten and is corroborative only.

title: Outer multiset dimension and all bases of half graphs
